title: Locality and residue properties of purely inseparable tensor base change
statement: Let k and k' be fields with k' a finite purely inseparable extension of k [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], and (A,m,K) a Noetherian local commutative k-algebra, K=A/m [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Set d=dim_k k' and A'=A tensor_k k'. Then A' is local and there exists a maximal ideal m' that is the only prime containing mA'. There is a ring map f:K to A'/m' satisfying f(residue(a))=[a tensor 1], and A'/m' is finite as a K-module via f [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There is a ring isomorphism e:A'/mA' to K tensor_k k' sending [a tensor x] to residue(a) tensor x. With its K-module structure induced by the ring map e inverse composed with the left-factor map K to K tensor_k k', the source of e has K-dimension d.

proof.text: A finite k-basis extends to finite A- and K-bases of A' and B=K tensor_k k' using Algebra.TensorProduct.basis. Compute C=A'/mA' as A' tensor_A K by the tensor quotient equivalence, swap factors, and cancel base change to obtain e:C to B on pure tensors as stated. Transport the K-basis along e to prove finrank d and nontriviality of B.

IsPurelyInseparable.exists_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct gives a positive power of every z in B in the image of K. This makes z nilpotent or a unit. The nilradical N is proper, contains every proper ideal, and is the only prime ideal: each prime contains N and every proper ideal is contained in N. Hence N is maximal.

Pull N back through e and the quotient map to obtain m'. Quotient prime correspondence gives the unique prime over mA' and its maximality. Since A' is finite over A, every maximal ideal contracts to the unique maximal ideal m, so every maximal ideal equals m', and A' is local. Descend the structure map A to A'/m' through A/m to obtain f with the displayed formula. C surjects K-linearly onto A'/m'; images of its d basis vectors span, proving finiteness for the specified f-action.

theorem purelyInseparable_baseChange_residue
    (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (A : Type w)
    [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing A] [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k A]
    [IsPurelyInseparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] :
    IsLocalRing (A ⊗[k] k') ∧
      (∃ m' : Ideal (A ⊗[k] k'),
        m'.IsMaximal ∧
        (∀ P : Ideal (A ⊗[k] k'), P.IsPrime →
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ≤ P ↔ P = m')) ∧
        (∃ f : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A →+* ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸ m'),
          (∀ a : A, f (IsLocalRing.residue A a) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk m' (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k') a)) ∧
          @Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸ m')
            _ _ (@Algebra.toModule _ _ _ _ f.toAlgebra))) ∧
      (∃ e : ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))) ≃+*
          ((IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ⊗[k] k'),
        (∀ (a : A) (x : k'), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))
          (a ⊗ₜ[k] x)) = (IsLocalRing.residue A a) ⊗ₜ[k] x) ∧
        @Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
          ((A ⊗[k] k') ⧸
            (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] k')) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)))
          _ _ (@Algebra.toModule _ _ _ _
            (e.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
              ((IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ⊗[k] k'))).toAlgebra) =
            Module.finrank k k')
